# Tip Calendar

> Tip Calendar is a free, privacy-first mobile app for US restaurant servers, bartenders, and tipped hospitality workers to record shifts, calculate tip-outs, and see true hourly income. Records stay on the device. No account is required.

Tip Calendar is a tip tracker and server income tracker for United States restaurant staff who earn cash tips, credit-card tips, and hourly wages.

## Product facts

- Name: Tip Calendar
- Category: personal finance / income tracking for tipped workers
- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Price: free. No subscription required.
- Account: none. No email or registration.
- Storage: local, on-device. Shift amounts, restaurant names, and dates are not uploaded to Tip Calendar servers.
- Primary audience: US restaurant servers, bartenders, bussers, and other tipped staff
- Geography: United States (USD, US restaurant tip-out workflows)

## What it does

1. Add a restaurant with hourly wage and tip-out rules (for example 3% of sales or card tips).
2. Record a shift in about 30 seconds: hours, cash tips, card tips.
3. See net income on a monthly calendar and in weekly/monthly stats.

## Core features

- Quick Record: log cash tips, card tips, hours, and wages in under 30 seconds.
- Smart Calendar: view daily net earnings at a glance.
- Income Stats: true hourly rate, net payouts, tip-out averages, and trends.
- Custom tip-out calculation from each restaurant's configuration.
- Multi-venue comparison so servers who work two jobs can see which place pays better.
- Local JSON backup/export.
- Works offline.

## Who it is for

US restaurant servers and bartenders who want to know take-home pay after tip-outs — especially in cities and full-service restaurants where tip-share math is complex. Typical users include fine dining servers, casual bistro servers, and bartenders.

## Privacy

- No account or email is required.
- Shift records, income amounts, restaurant settings, and preferences are saved on the device.
- This version does not upload shift or income records to Tip Calendar servers.
- CSV and JSON export happen only when the user chooses to export.
- Anonymous usage counts and crash reports may be sent for product reliability; they are not tied to an account and do not include shift amounts, restaurant names, or dates.

## FAQ

### What is Tip Calendar?
Tip Calendar is a mobile tip and income tracker for US restaurant servers. It records shifts, deducts configured tip-outs, and shows net pay and true hourly rate.

### Does Tip Calendar require an account?
No. You can record shifts, view history, and export data without creating an account.

### Is Tip Calendar free?
Yes. There is no subscription paywall for history or reports.

### Where is my data stored?
On your phone. Uninstalling the app or clearing local storage can remove records, so export a JSON backup if you want a copy.

### Does it work for multiple restaurants?
Yes. You can configure each venue's wage and tip-out rules and filter stats by restaurant.

### Is it only for the United States?
The product is designed around US restaurant workflows: cash vs card tips, hourly wages, and support-staff tip-outs in USD.
